# rework_claims_r4 — cpi_insurance_verification_and_force_placement (coordinator ruling round 4; audit revision_2 items kept closed)

- Ruling (counts fixed, 7/7 gates, only the listed real schedule forms): draws placed where an honest ladder set exists — task 0: feed re-review 6, upload (binder) re-review 4, closing-month refund 4; task 1: fax re-review 6, closing-period refund 4. All seven gates pass.
- Re-review factors (one schedule in all three rules, one record dimension per factor): comprehensive deductible allowance by model year; collision deductible allowances by vehicle book value and by credit tier; reach date by record status (method). Policies (feed, fax) also carry the expiry buffer by contract state and the minimum policy term by loan-to-value at signing. Uploaded binders keep the base binder-period test and the reach test with no buffer or minimum term (binders are temporary by nature), which is why that rule carries four factors.
- Refund factors (one schedule in both refund rules): coverage-span counting (method: union of two reaching proofs / one proof ending inside the period / insurer reinstatement without a gap / base days from the latest effective date); lapse tolerance per uncovered stretch by credit tier; closing-day adjustment by payoff funds finality; day basis by contract state rate filing. The refund is unearned premium only; no shares, credits, tenure grading, insurer-identity caps or interest.
- R2-A (assembly): the deductible ceilings and the refundable days are combined by generic sentences ("the plan maximum plus every allowance this rule states"; "refundable days add together every day count this rule states"), naming no factor-decided quantity.
- R2-B (coinciding tiers): every ladder's tiers select distinct values or methods; the lienholder ladder stays removed (base own-flag test); the finance factor stays removed.
- R2-C (unreachable fall-through): every fall-through is reachable in scope (contract states, tiers, model years, book values, payoff channels and reach states outside the scheduled ones).
- R2-D (unreal schedules): no struck schedule returns; the lapse tolerance is a per-stretch counting convention keyed to the contract's credit tier, not to compliance tenure.
- R2-E (tails): re-review tails keep only first reviews and agent-call proofs under the base open-record rule and hand each named sibling to its own rule; refund tails name each other and keep flat cancellation, pro rata from proof and pro rata from closure for every other charge.
- R2-F (edges): reach date, buffer and minimum term are stated per record field (first review date, repossession_date, re-review date; amount_financed_usd over vehicle_book_value_usd); absent proofs and absent contract fields resolve without a failing read; probe table in plan.md "Round 4 probe table".
- R2-G (interest in the premium refund): none.
- Seeds: proof dates and deductibles re-seeded (binder 11 days, short-term policies of 10 days, deductibles set so each allowance carries the acceptance); contracts unchanged inside Tier 5 / Tier 4 term and LTV limits; ledgers from origination unchanged.
- Personas: unchanged in role; coverage start dates updated to the re-seeded proofs; no line comments on a figure.
- Proof text: rationales, traces, tier_taken, seed_consistency, necessity and argument traces regenerated from replayed bindings.
